create_generational_cache: create a GenerationalCache instance with custom thresholds and max entry size
get_cache_value: get a cached value by key from the GenerationalCache with hit tracking
set_cache_entry: set a key-value pair in the GenerationalCache using bracket assignment syntax
map_batches_with_cache: map a batch function over an iterable with automatic caching of results
purge_cache: purge cache entries from the GenerationalCache when it exceeds max entry limit
